title: Issue<->backlog close loop not wired end-to-end (pieces existed, loop never exercised)
body: Gap from BI-PF-0262: raise_issue did not auto-raise the paired backlog and issue close did not propagate back with fixed_where.

rcca.root_cause: Verification proved the PARTS existed (unit-level) but not the PROCESS end-to-end (RC-1 failure mode: existence != execution); the loop was assumed wired without an e2e test of the described sequence.
rcca.corrective: raise_issue(auto_backlog=True) now raises the paired backlog (dedup-checked) and links 1:1; issues.set_status(closed) propagates completion + fixed_where to the backlog item; fail-closed both ways.
rcca.preventive: For every process claim, write the e2e test of the exact sequence FIRST; parts-only verification is insufficient.
rcca.guideline_ref: EOS G2/G6 (run-bound evidence; a check must be able to fail)
